final: SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) - (SELECT AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds <> 0) AS above_all_album_average FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds <> 0 GROUP BY AlbumId ORDER BY above_all_album_average DESC LIMIT 10
